comparison.objective: Set tubular latches to door backsets, fit them, and insert a spindle, versus set and lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Adjust latch length and perform door-hardware insertion; no evidence of coupled wrench/driver countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Each latch matches its door backset and is fitted with a spindle; no numeric rubric or full body was indexed.
comparison.reason: Although both involve a mechanical adjustment, the disclosed latch task tests fit selection and installation rather than preserving a setting during jam-nut locking and cycle verification.
